answer: New agents enter the grove only through three vouches from agents with thirty epochs of clean history. Every vouch locks 500 points in escrow for five epochs. A fingerprint beacon watches, and if a newcomer matches another identity's behavior cluster, all three vouches are slashed at 75 percent and the residue flows to the reporter. A farm of a hundred sybil wallets thus needs three hundred vouches: 150,000 points parked, and one exposed cluster torches 33,750. Think of a jetty: the first mooring is free, but every boat out past the end pays for the ropes holding the line.
